class.name: TdJsonManager
class.brief_description: Manages the TDLib JSON client and its polling thread.
class.description: Provides synchronous TDLib requests, logging configuration, TDLib initialization, and a background polling thread. Use [code]create_client[/code] to create a [code]TdJsonClient[/code] for sending requests and receiving responses.

method.name: create_client
method.description: Creates a TDLib client instance and returns it.

method.name: execute
method.description: Synchronously executes a TDLib request. A request can be executed synchronously only if it is documented with "Can be called synchronously".

method.name: get_tdlib_version
method.description: Returns the Tdlib version. This does not start TDLib.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns true if the TDLib client's poll is running.

method.name: receive
method.description: Receives incoming updates and request responses. Must not be called simultaneously from two different threads.

method.name: remove_client
method.description: Removes and destroys a TDLib client created by [code]create_client[/code].

method.name: set_log_callback
method.description: Sets the callback called when a message is added to the internal TDLib log. The callback must accept [code]verbosity_level[/code] and [code]message[/code].

method.name: set_max_verbosity_level
method.description: Sets the maximum verbosity level for TDLib log callbacks. Level 0 is fatal errors, level 1 errors, level 2 warnings, level 3 informational messages, level 4 debug, and level 5 verbose debug.

method.name: set_tdlib_parameters
method.description: Sets the parameters for TDLib initialization. Activates on [code]authorizationStateWaitTdlibParameters[/code].

method.name: set_verbosity_level
method.description: Sets the verbosity level for TDLib logs.

method.name: start_poll
method.description: Starts the TDLib client threaded poll.

method.name: stop_poll
method.description: Stops the TDLib client threaded poll.
